hints.content: The graph of function $f$ is the graph of function $h$ shifted up $8$ units.

To shift the graph of $y=h(x)$ up $8$ units, we can replace $h(x)$ with $h(x)+8$ in the equation. 

[[☃ image 1]]



Notice that this is the graph of function $f$, and so $f(x)=h(x)+8$.

options.alt: Two congruent square root graphs labeled h of x and h of x in parentheses plus eight on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. The graph labeled h of x has an endpoint at (negative three, negative two) and passes through the (six, one) The graph labeled h of x in parentheses plus eight has an endpoint at (negative three, six) and passes through the point (six, nine).
